author: Just Jared
title: Sabrina Carpenter Teases 'House Tour' Music Video With Margaret Qualley & Madelyn Cline - Watch Now! - NewsBreak
text:
By Just Jared ,
11 hours ago Sabrina Carpenter just released a new teaser for her next music video – “ House Tour “!
The 26-year-old singer and actress is gearing up for another cinematic visual, this time for a fan-favorite song from her latest album Man’s Best Friend .
“no joke… house tour video this Monday 🩷 xo,” she captioned a clip on Instagram.
Keep reading to find out more…
In the short video tease, we see Sabrina driving a pink vehicle with a cigarette in hand, while Madelyn Cline sits in the middle patting her face with a makeup pad, and Margaret Qualley in the passenger seat licking a lollipop.
At the end of the clip, Madelyn says, “Should we use the back door?”
This is a call back to a line in the song’s second chorus, “I just want you to come inside (Come inside) / But never enter through the back door.”
“House Tour” is the latest single off of Man’s Best Friend , following “Manchild” and “Tears.” The music video is set to be released on Monday (April 6).
Sabrina has regularly featured popular actors in her music videos. Past video co-stars include Jenna Ortega , Barry Keoghan , Colman Domingo , Dolly Parton and Joey King .
The singer was recently nominated for several Grammys for Man’s Best Friend and the “Manchild” music video, but unfortunately didn’t pick up a win this time.
She also performed the single at the February awards show!
